Make time for yourself

Our menu includes Swedish massage, deep tissue, aromatherapy, couple massage, hot stone massage, body scrub and steam, and Moroccan bath treatments done in steam.

Listed treatments range from UGX 100,000 to UGX 350,000. Choose your preferred treatment and duration from the full menu. Our team will confirm availability and the final total.

How to book in Bukoto

  1. Open the booking form and choose one or more treatments.
  2. Select Bukoto as your branch and enter your preferred date, time and contact details.
  3. Review your request, continue to WhatsApp and tap Send. Your appointment is confirmed when the spa replies.
Choose your treatments ↗

Before you visit

Please confirm opening hours and your preferred appointment time with the team before travelling. For groups or couples, mention the number of guests in your request.
